# Maher Khan

> Maher Khan is an AI Content Strategist, social media strategist and digital marketer based in San Jose, California, and an Adobe Brand Ambassador for Adobe Express and Adobe Firefly. 10+ years in digital marketing and 8+ years managing social media. Former Assistant Professor of Marketing. Designed the Agentic AI Marketing course at UCLA Extension.

She helps hiring teams and small businesses with social media strategy, social media management, content strategy, Meta ads, Reels and video content, and AI training for marketing teams. Open to full-time Content Strategist, Senior Content Strategist, Social Media Manager and Digital Marketing roles, remote or in the San Francisco Bay Area.
